# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

body: I'm not super happy with this, we have way too much code to support the select cases, but I'll accept it as an interim solution. Select will need one more round of refactoring, because all cases, except for select-to-select unbuffered channel, can be solved cleanly with much less code. The complexity only comes from the unbuffered channels and those can be special cases to contain the complexity there.
Please remove the examples, but leave them in the previous commits. I'll merge the branch, so I can refer to the older commits, if needed.

Done in 5124ea7. The tip no longer ships the two examples, and build.zig is back to its upstream shape (the posix_only machinery existed only for the reproducer). The examples stay in the branch history: the reproducer's final shape is in 03b2646, and the two-driver death test is in 0c9271c. The tip's diff against main is now src/completion_queue.zig only.

Understood on the interim status. If the select refactoring lands and you want the CompletionQueue arm re-validated against the same harness, ping me; it flags an occurrence within a few ten-second rounds.
